part.text:
All 25 tests pass. The implementation in `grep.py` handles each flag per the spec:

- **`-n`** — prepends the line number (after the filename, when present)
- **`-l`** — prints the filename once and moves on to the next file, taking precedence over `-n`
- **`-i`** — lowercases both pattern and line before comparing
- **`-v`** — keeps lines that fail to match
- **`-x`** — requires the whole line to equal the pattern
- **Multiple files** — prefixes each match with `filename:` (only when more than one file is searched)

The one subtlety: the tests patch `grep.open` with `create=True`, so the function calls the built-in `open` directly, which the mock intercepts.
